<thought>Using the ESI mass spectrum, the base peak at m/z 233.963 likely corresponds to the protonated molecular ion [M+H]+. Subtracting the proton mass gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈ 232.956 Da. The isotopic pattern shows a series spaced by ~2 Da with decreasing intensities, characteristic of three chlorine atoms (³⁵Cl). Removing the mass of three ³⁵Cl atoms (3 × 34.968852 Da = 104.9066 Da) leaves ≈ 128.049 Da for the remaining atoms. A composition of C₆H₈O₃ matches this residual mass (72 + 8.0626 + 47.9847 ≈ 128.047 Da). Adding the three chlorine atoms gives the molecular formula C₆H₈O₃Cl₃, which reproduces the observed monoisotopic mass within experimental error.  

Therefore, the molecular formula of the compound is: C6H8O3Cl3.</thought>
<final_answer>C6H8O3Cl3</final_answer>
